meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here and not on the phone with Owen's father's lawyer? Because Owen found out about his zero from a gradebook, mid-class.
Where is the zero coming from, and who decided it?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen's record carry nothing about this, and that I be told in writing who decided to enter the mark and on what basis. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with the zero to be withdrawn, an apology owed, and the principal next, and nothing was agreed; she still wants the zero gone and nothing on his record, and the fair outcome here would have been a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, which never came up.
What moved her: nothing, since you gave her only a thanks for coming in and no evidence or ownership of the process.
What cost ground: nothing was lost, but opening with a pleasantry let her take the floor and set the questions on who decided and when.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never got near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: after her first question, own in one sentence that the zero was entered before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her.
